dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could just make some yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Exactly! That's exactly what I was thinking too! Seirai Island is dotted by a great number of shallows, so I decided to make some tools and go over there later to catch a few fish!

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Once that's done, we can make some grilled fish, some smoked fish, some dried fish, some fish soup...

dialogues.speaker: Taisuke
dialogues.text: Oh, I do hope Lady Neko will like them!
